common_constraints.missing_value_rule: Missing or unrecoverable fields remain explicitly missing; zero is never used as a surrogate for missing.
common_constraints.normalization_rule: Any fitted normalization in a later experiment must be fit on Known Train only and then applied unchanged to Known Validation/Test/Unknown Test.

feature_groups.name: Native raw-byte image
fields: 80 bytes zero-addressed IPv4/header serialization per packet
48 bytes Scapy Raw payload per packet
feature_groups.input_shape: 1 x 32 x 32 uint8 image; ToTensor maps to [0,1]
feature_groups.truncation: Discard packets after packet 8 and bytes beyond each fixed slot
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Transport ports and other non-address header fields remain visible; capture/domain artifacts may be encoded.

feature_groups.name: Packet-structured bytes
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: X[i,j]=jth retained byte of packet i; masks distinguish structural padding from observed zero bytes
feature_groups.input_shape: N x L bytes plus N x L byte mask and N packet mask
feature_groups.bytes_per_packet: to be frozen before Stage 15F-1; no search on Test
feature_groups.padding: Explicit masks; right-pad packets and packet slots
feature_groups.truncation: First-N packets, first-L retained bytes per packet
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Header identifiers, ports, addresses, checksums, capture signatures and padding can leak labels unless explicitly masked.

feature_groups.name: Header-only bytes
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: B2_i = serialized visible headers after preregistered identifier masking
feature_groups.bytes_per_packet: variable headers padded to frozen L_header
feature_groups.truncation: First-N packets; header parsing failure is missing, not zero
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Highest direct risk from addresses, ports, sequence numbers, checksums and dataset-specific tunnel headers.

feature_groups.name: Transport-payload-only bytes
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: B3_i = bytes after parsed transport header in the observed packet
feature_groups.truncation: First-N packets and first-L_payload observed bytes
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Encrypted payload can still expose record framing, lengths and deterministic capture artifacts; tunnel payload is not inner application payload.

feature_groups.name: Header plus payload with explicit boundary
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: B4_i = (B2_i, separator, B3_i) with segment and validity masks
feature_groups.input_shape: N x (L_header + L_payload) plus segment/mask tensors
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Combines B2 and B3 risks; must retain identifier-masking audit.

feature_groups.name: Signed packet length plus IAT sequence
feature_groups.padding: Zero values with an explicit mask
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Capture tooling, MTU, tunnel overhead and application duration can be dataset/domain signatures.

feature_groups.name: Burst representation
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: Group consecutive packets with identical nonzero direction into ordered bursts and aggregate count/bytes/duration/gap
feature_groups.packet_window: EARLY_N_PACKET-derived or FULL_FLOW; treated as distinct configurations
feature_groups.normalization: Known-Train robust scaling after log1p of nonnegative magnitudes
feature_groups.truncation: First-M bursts or bursts induced by first-N packets, declared explicitly
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Long-capture and tunnel scheduling artifacts; FULL_FLOW version uses future packets unavailable to an early detector.

feature_groups.name: Twelve audited flow statistics
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: Full-flow scalar vector; unavailable payload fields remain missing and require a preregistered missingness treatment
feature_groups.normalization: Known-Train log transforms plus robust scaling
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Duration/volume can encode capture scripts and cannot be compared directly with EARLY_N latency.

feature_groups.name: Expanded bidirectional statistics
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: Deterministic full-flow aggregates with direction defined by the first observed endpoint
feature_groups.input_shape: fixed scalar vector; exact dimension frozen with extractor schema
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Same as S1 plus TCP-state and capture-duration artifacts; domain metadata is excluded from the feature vector.

feature_groups.name: Byte plus temporal fusion
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: Late fusion of independently encoded byte and temporal branches with a fixed preregistered fusion operator
feature_groups.input_shape: two branch tensors; fused latent dimension frozen before training
feature_groups.truncation: same first-N packets for both branches
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Union of byte and temporal risks; incompatible horizons must not be silently fused.

feature_groups.name: Byte plus statistical fusion
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: Late fusion of byte encoder output and scalar-statistics encoder output
feature_groups.packet_window: EARLY_N+EARLY_N statistics or FULL_FLOW+FULL_FLOW only; mixed latency is a separate declared experiment
feature_groups.padding: explicit byte masks; scalar missingness indicators
feature_groups.leakage_risk: FULL_FLOW scalar branch can invalidate an early-byte claim.

feature_groups.name: Byte plus temporal plus statistical fusion
feature_groups.mathematical_definition: One fixed fusion of the three independently gated feature families
feature_groups.padding: explicit masks and scalar missingness indicators
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Largest capacity and artifact risk; not allowed before B/T/S single-group screening.

feature_groups.name: Frozen or minimally tuned pretrained traffic encoder
feature_groups.input_shape: model-specific and must be recorded from paper plus code
feature_groups.normalization: official implementation only unless labeled independent adaptation
feature_groups.supported_datasets: only datasets whose recoverable fields satisfy the official input contract
feature_groups.leakage_risk: Pretraining corpus overlap, tokenizer/header leakage, unavailable weights, and mismatch between published and local preprocessing.
